TITLE: Why is summer hot?
NEXT: NEXT: Why does the Moon change shape?

EN.여름엔 지구가\n해와 더 가까워서 더울까요?:
Is summer hot because Earth
is closer to the Sun?
EN.해와 가장 가까운 때는 1월 초\n우리나라는 한겨울이에요:
Earth is closest to the Sun in early January —
the middle of winter in Korea
EN.진짜 이유는\n기울어진 지구!:
The real reason:
Earth is tilted!
EN.6월엔 우리나라가\n해 쪽으로 기울어요:
In June, Korea
leans toward the Sun
EN.손전등으로 보면\n똑바로 비추면 좁고 밝게:
Think of a flashlight:
shine it straight down and the spot is small and bright
EN.비스듬히 비추면\n넓고 흐리게 퍼져요:
Shine it at a slant
and it spreads out wide and dim
EN.같은 빛인데 한 칸이 받는 빛이\n여름엔 많고, 겨울엔 적어요:
Same light, but each square gets
more in summer and less in winter
EN.여름엔 한낮의 해가 높이 떠서\n햇빛을 똑바로 받아요:
In summer the midday Sun is high,
so sunlight hits more directly
EN.낮도 길어서\n오래오래 데워져요:
Days are longer too,
so things warm up for a long time
EN.겨울엔 해가 낮게 뜨고\n낮도 짧아요:
In winter the Sun stays low
and the days are short
EN.어두운 방에서 손전등을\n종이에 똑바로 · 비스듬히!:
Try it in a dark room:
shine a flashlight on paper, straight and slanted!
